profile.name: Velan D
profile.description: Software Developer & Full-Stack Freelancer with a passion for building robust web applications, AI tools, low-level socket utilities, and resilient backend systems.
profile.bioLead: I am a software developer and independent freelancer with an unyielding curiosity for how things work under the hood — from high-level web applications down to low-level Linux socket communications.
profile.bioStory: Whether it's building interactive user experiences, architecting AI-powered tools like DreamCatcher and Resume-Matcher, or profiling network round-trip latencies in C++, I believe in crafting software that is not only functional, but clean, maintainable, and reliable.
profile.bioPersonal: Beyond the terminal and editor, I am a passionate football enthusiast and a proud admirer of Lionel Messi's playmaking artistry — a standard of precision, composure under pressure, and vision that I strive to bring into my engineering craft.

projects.title: DreamCatcher
projects.desc: An interactive web application that captures user dreams, performs semantic interpretation, and breaks down recurring subconscious themes into actionable reflections.
features: Interactive dream logging interface with sentiment indicators
Semantic parsing to extract key symbolic archetypes and metaphors
Responsive, modern UI designed with modular styling and dark mode support
Fast lightweight frontend architecture with zero bloated dependencies

projects.title: Resume-Matcher & Analyzer
projects.desc: An intelligent AI harness designed for parsing resumes, comparing candidates against job descriptions, and generating tailored PDF resumes and cover letters with multi-LLM support.
features: Multi-LLM provider compatibility for local and cloud model inference
Automated scoring algorithm measuring skills alignment and experience match
Document parsing pipeline for PDFs, docx, and raw markdown resumes
Modular architecture facilitating custom prompt templates and evaluation metrics

projects.title: Socket Ping & Linux Networking
projects.desc: High-performance Linux network tool implemented in C++ utilizing low-level POSIX sockets to measure Round Trip Time (RTT), packet jitter, and transmission health.
features: Raw POSIX socket configuration for low-overhead packet dispatch
Microsecond-precision Round Trip Time (RTT) timing and statistical analysis
Robust error handling for socket timeouts, unreachable hosts, and packet loss
Portable Unix/Linux architecture suitable for embedded and server diagnostics

projects.title: System & Website Ping Monitor
projects.desc: Automated Python tool that tracks website response codes, server latency, and system health metrics, providing early incident detection and status reporting.
features: Configurable polling intervals and multi-endpoint tracking
Latency tracking with threshold-based alerting
Lightweight footprint capable of running as a systemd background service
CSV/Log export capabilities for long-term reliability audits

projects.title: Responsive Developer Portfolio
projects.desc: High-performance static portfolio website built with modern CSS variables, fluid responsive layouts, theme persistence, and frictionless GitHub Pages deployment.
features: 100/100 Lighthouse performance with zero heavy JavaScript frameworks
System-aware and user-toggled dark/light theme persistence
Accessible modal dialogs, clipboard actions, and responsive layout
Seamless deployment on GitHub Pages with zero-build or Vite workflow support

projects.title: Linux Socket Programming Library
projects.desc: Clean, documented Linux socket implementations demonstrating client-server communication, packet handling, and multi-client connection management.
features: Clean encapsulation of socket creation, binding, listening, and accepting
Non-blocking socket handling and multiplexing principles
Well-documented codebase designed as a reference for low-level network engineers
Direct POSIX Linux integration
